## 2. Logic Chain

1. **Step 1: Eradicating DOM Sinks via Pure DOM Construction**:
   - From Observation 1, all 11 instances of `.innerHTML =` introduce DOM sink attack surfaces and violate Milestone UI-M2 non-negotiable invariants.
   - Replacing template strings with `document.createElement`, `classList`, `textContent`, and `setAttribute` guarantees zero script execution or injection vulnerabilities.
   - For SVG elements (e.g. star rating badges), using `document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', ...)` creates valid XML DOM nodes with exact `viewBox`, `fill`, and `points` attributes without needing string-to-DOM parsing sinks.
   - For container clearing, `while (el.firstChild) { el.removeChild(el.firstChild); }` cleanly unbinds and removes child nodes with zero DOM sinks.
   - Setting `titleH3.textContent = title` automatically entity-escapes special characters and HTML tags (as verified: `<script>alert(1)</script>` serializes to `<script>alert(1)</script>`), satisfying both `adversarial-m2.js` and `forensic-m4.js`.
